headline: Adani Enterprises Limited: Qualified Institutional Placement - Closure and Pricing Approval
sum: Adani Enterprises closed its QIP with approval of placement documents and pricing, as intimated to NSE on 7 July 2026, marking completion of the qualified institutional capital raise.
detail: Adani Enterprises Limited obtained NSE approval for closure of its Qualified Institutional Placement and ratification of pricing and placement documents as of 7 July 2026. SBI Caps served as placement adviser. The QIP was conducted under SEBI (ICDR) Regulations 2018, permitting equity issuance to qualified institutional buyers without public offer mechanics. Specific issue size and per-share pricing remain subject to verification in the final placement letter and board resolutions.
